parts.text:
In Urberia, the masses, in kilograms, of men have the distribution $\text{N}(70.3, 5.9^2)$. A certain footbridge in Urberia can take a maximum safe load of 1500 kg. When $n$ men stand on the bridge, the probability that the bridge is unsafe is less than 0.01.

Stating a necessary assumption, find the maximum value of $n$.
